prompt: Order the steps for using an AI assistant to draft a client status report.

task.prompt: Drag the items into the right order, first at the top.

items.label: Check every number and date against the source
Send, and file the final version
Gather the facts: tracker, RAID log, timesheets
Edit the tone and add your own judgement
Prompt the AI with the facts, audience and format

task.explanation: Facts in, check facts out: the AI drafts, you stay accountable.

prompt: An AI assistant drafted minutes of today's client call. You were on the call, and a transcript is saved.

steps.question: Before sending the minutes to the client you:
options: Check decisions, owners, dates and numbers against the transcript
Send as is; the AI heard everything
Send with "AI-generated, may contain errors"
Rewrite it all from memory
steps.explanation: You own the minutes; check what matters against the source.

steps.question: The draft says the client "approved the extra sprint"; the transcript says they'll "think about it". You:
options: Change it to "considering; decision due by a date"
Keep it; it helps the plan
Delete the line
Ask the AI to reword it
steps.explanation: Record what was said, plus the follow-up.

prompt: AI drafted this status email from your tracker: 34 of 40 stories done, go-live 22 Nov, 71% of budget used. Mark what's wrong.

task.prompt: Mark every segment that is a problem. Leave the sound ones unmarked.

segments.text: Hi Priya, here's this week's update on the Acme portal.
Go-live remains on track for 15 November.
We've used 71% of the budget so far.
Our QA pass rate this sprint is 98%.
segments.issue: Not in the tracker: an invented figure.

segments.text: Let me know if you have any questions.

prompt: AI suggested the formula in **F2** for Ann's total hours, but it returns 0. Fix F2 so it sums Ann's hours.

task.explanation: The AI summed column B (project names, text) instead of C (hours). Test AI formulas on a row whose answer you know.

prompt: You want an AI tool to summarise a client's 40-page contract and its rates spreadsheet.

steps.question: Before pasting anything in, you check:
options: Which AI tools your company approves, and whether client data may go in
That the tool is free
That the file is under 10 MB
Nothing; summaries are harmless
steps.explanation: Client contracts are confidential; the tool must be approved for that data.

steps.question: Only a public consumer chatbot is available. You:
options: Don't paste it; use an approved tool or remove names and figures first
Paste it; the chatbot is popular
Paste only the rates
Ask the client afterwards
steps.explanation: Don't put confidential client data into unapproved tools.

prompt: Transcript: Ravi sends the UAT build Friday; Priya (client) confirms gateway keys by Wednesday; PM updates the SOW next week. Flag AI action items that don't match.

task.prompt: Flag action items that don't match the transcript.
task.title: AI meeting recap — action items

rows.issue: The owner is Priya, not Ravi.

prompt: Write the prompt you'd give an AI assistant to draft this week's client status email from your notes.

task.prompt: Write the prompt (max 20 words): what to use, audience, format, and what it must not do.

rubric.label: Grounded in your notes
rubric.description: Tells the AI to use only the pasted notes or tracker as its source.

rubric.label: Audience and format
rubric.description: Names the reader (the client) and the shape: length, sections such as progress, risks, next steps.

rubric.label: Guardrails
rubric.description: Says not to invent figures or dates, or to flag anything missing.

task.sampleAnswer: Using only my notes below, draft a 150-word status email to the client: progress, risks, next steps. Never invent numbers.

prompt: AI polished your delay email to Acme. Facts: gateway delay, go-live 22 Nov, UAT 10–14 Nov, updates every Friday. Mark what you must remove.

task.prompt: Mark every segment that is a problem. Leave the sound ones unmarked.

segments.text: Due to a payment gateway delay, go-live moves to 22 November.
We guarantee there will be no further delays.
This is entirely the gateway provider's fault.
segments.issue: Blaming tone; not the message to send.

segments.text: We'll update you every Friday until launch.
As discussed, we'll waive the change-request fee.

options: Confident output that is false or not in the source
A slow response
A refusal to answer
A formatting error
mcq.explanation: Models can produce fluent, plausible text that isn't true, which is why figures and dates need checking.

prompt: Which prompt will get the most useful status-report draft?

options: The facts, the audience, the format and what not to do
"Write a status report"
The whole project mailbox, no instructions
The same request in capitals
mcq.explanation: Specific inputs and constraints give specific, checkable output.

prompt: An AI gives you an Excel formula for the client tracker. Before using it you:

options: Test it on rows where you know the answer
Trust it if it shows no error
Ask the AI if it's sure
Paste it into every sheet
mcq.explanation: A formula can run without errors and still be wrong; test against a known answer.

prompt: An AI tool estimates a feature at 3 days. How do you use that?

options: As a starting point to confirm with the devs who'll build it
Send it to the client as the quote
Halve it
Ignore all AI estimates
mcq.explanation: The team doing the work owns the estimate; an AI figure is a prompt for discussion.
